purpose: Fill the post-2025 Heists / 120 Thieving gap in training-methods.json: heists, archaeology professors, high-level pickpocket ladders, and premium equipment (Ring of Vitur) / Summoning charm notes. Rates are base-game wiki references before Equilibrium multipliers. Safecracking circuits and multi-step chests already seeded in training-methods.json are not duplicated.

methods.level_range: 95+; 102 Thieving recommended for safes (98 with abyssal lurker scroll, 101 with Thieving cape boost)
methods.xp_rate: About 1,200,000–1,350,000 base XP/h at 95 without safes (~180k XP per 8–9 min run); about 1,900,000 base XP/h with safes at full 500 loot points (~315k XP per ~10 min perfect run).
methods.intensity: high-intensity route and timing; active heist
methods.location: Kharid-et Dig Site (sealed vault wing); speak to Liara at entrance
methods.notes: Primary 95–108 Thieving path after the Nov 2025 heists update. Base exit XP is 400 per loot point with rare chest looted; leaving without the rare chest halves loot for XP/rewards. Sticky Fingers / Crystal Mask / Light Form / Ring of Vitur strongly recommended for dead-legionary pickpockets. Logging out resets progress and deletes loot.

methods.level_range: 108+; 114 Thieving recommended for safes (110 with abyssal lurker scroll, 113 with Thieving cape boost)
methods.xp_rate: About 1,600,000 base XP/h at 108 without safes (~230k XP per 8.5–9 min run); about 2,260,000 base XP/h with safes at full 500 loot points (~340k XP per ~9 min perfect run).
methods.intensity: high-intensity dangerous heist (trap damage + loot loss; deaths unsafe)
methods.location: South-east Anachronia (near Anachronia Swamp Fortress shore); speak to Liara at entrance
requirements: 75/85/97 Agility for rubble / crevices / railings on full routes
methods.notes: Top-end Thieving XP method post-108. Base exit XP is 450 per loot point with rare chest looted. Unlike Vault of Hereditas, traps deal damage and deaths are unsafe; food / Enhanced Excalibur / bone shield recommended. Logging out or dying resets progress and deletes loot.

methods.xp_rate: Up to about 987,000 base XP/h with uninterrupted successful pickpockets (493.5 XP per success).
methods.intensity: low-input AFK once success chance is high; refresh Crystal Mask every 5 minutes
methods.location: Any Archaeology dig site professor (Archaeology Campus spawn is Misthalin / starting-friendly; other dig sites rematch region)
requirements: Crystal Mask + Light Form + master camouflage recommended for high success by ~111
methods.notes: Best AFK alternative when heists are too active or Anachronia/Desert is locked. Loot is dig-site material/artefact tables plus chronotes and rare binding contracts — strong Archaeology/self-supply value in a no-trading League, not a primary charm farm. Dig-site spawns span multiple regions: Campus/Infernal Source/Senntisten → Misthalin; Kharid-et → desert; Everlight → morytania; Stormguard/Warforge → kandarin; Daemonheim → forinthry/Wilderness (wiki tags Wilderness); Orthen → anachronia.
methods.region_note: Primary planner region is misthalin via Archaeology Campus. Treat dig-site choice as optional regional material routing, not a hard lock on the method existing.

methods.xp_rate: About 844,000 base XP/h on the current Thieving training pickpocket ladder.
methods.intensity: low-input pickpocketing; Darkmeyer aggression management until Ring of Vitur
methods.notes: Bridge target between traders and professors on the post-100 AFK ladder. Pairs with Darkmeyer multi-step chest / vyre consumer routes when farming Ring of Vitur.

methods.xp_rate: About 966,000 base XP/h on the current Thieving training pickpocket ladder.
methods.notes: Starting-region AFK step just below archaeology professors; useful when Desert/Anachronia heists are unavailable.

methods.xp_rate: About 1,008,000 base XP/h on the current Thieving training pickpocket ladder.
methods.notes: Post-professor AFK ladder rung; Karamja-locked elective.

methods.xp_rate: About 1,050,000 base XP/h on the current Thieving training pickpocket ladder.
methods.notes: High AFK ladder step. Region is working-inferred via Zanaris / Lost City pipeline into the starting Misthalin bucket; confirm if Equilibrium re-tags Zanaris.

methods.xp_rate: About 1,155,000 base XP/h on the current Thieving training pickpocket ladder.
methods.notes: Highest pure-pickpocket XP rung on the wiki ladder (~1.155m base). Also a Ring of Vitur source (1/20,000–1/19,400 with luck scaling). Prefer for AFK XP + Vitur chase when Morytania is unlocked; still far below heist XP ceilings.
premium_loot: Ring of Vitur (rare; also from Darkmeyer magic stall 117 and Darkmeyer multi-step chests 116)

methods.level_range: 91–99+ by clan; practical from ~96 without Crystal Mask, boostable from 90 with Crystal Mask
methods.xp_rate: About 373,000 base XP/h at 99 with Trahaearn exoskeleton (Voice of Seren and clan routing heavily affect rates).
methods.intensity: semi-AFK with clan strike lockouts (20 min; 15 with Anachronia Totem of Crystal)
methods.notes: Not competitive with heists or professors on pure XP after the 2025 update, but remains the classic Tirannwn Thieving unlock and a strong Ironman supply route (potions, porter signs, herblore secondaries). Cadarn multi-step chest (already in training-methods.json) is the better Tirannwn pure-XP chest alternative at 103+.

effects: Prevents vyrewatch aggression (frees armour slots for master camouflage / other thieving gear in Darkmeyer)
sources: Darkmeyer multi-step thieving chests (116) — best drop rate ~1/5,000–1/4,850
unlock_notes.league_note: Hard Morytania premium for any pickpocket-heavy plan (heists, professors, vyres). Added in the same 24 Nov 2025 Thieving update as heists. Wiki tags stall/chests as Morytania League region.

unlock_notes.detail: Classic pickpocket ladders (guards through elves/traders and other mid-high NPCs) remain a no-trading League charm source for Summoning pouches. Heists and archaeology professors are not charm-primary: heists roll coin/salvage/spirit tables; professors roll chronotes/materials/artefacts/binding contracts. Do not plan Summoning charm supply around heists or professors — keep charm drops attached to traditional pickpocket targets and other known charm methods.
unlock_notes.league_note: In Equilibrium, charm throughput is a soft reason to keep some pickpocket targets in the planner even when heists dominate XP/hour.

unlock_notes.topic: Crystal Mask + Light Form success stack
effects: Crystal Mask: +15% pickpocket success for 5 minutes (recast refreshes target suspicion)
Light Form: doubles Seren spell effect → Crystal Mask becomes +30% pickpocket success
requirements: The Light Within (Tirannwn) for Crystal Mask and Light Form
Ancient Curses via The Temple at Senntisten for Light Form prayer book access
region_issues: Full +30% stack is a Tirannwn prayer/spell package (seren-light-within profile also pulls Temple at Senntisten recursive regions: asgarnia, desert, fremennik, kandarin, misthalin, tirannwn).
Without Tirannwn, high-level pickpocket AFK (professors, vyre consumers, traders) is substantially worse; heists still function but dead-legionary / lock success benefits less.
Grace of the elves / Dark Facet of Grace (Tirannwn) further cuts Light Form prayer cost — optional but common with this stack.

unlock_notes.detail: Trahaearn exoskeleton (Plague's End) gives stun avoidance and +5% pickpocket success on bracers at 75 Thieving/Hunter. Master camouflage consolidates desert + Keldagrim + Prif camouflage sets and inherits black ibis XP when owned. Black ibis itself is Pyramid Plunder (desert). Camouflage teleports and pickpocket double-loot chances are major QoL for both heists and AFK.
region_issues: Full master camouflage is multi-region grind (desert + fremennik/Keldagrim + tirannwn).
Exoskeleton alone is Tirannwn-locked via Plague's End.

region_issues.issue: Heist peak XP is region-split: Vault of Hereditas = desert (Kharid-et); Asuran Arsenal = anachronia. No single elective unlocks both top heists.
region_issues.impact: Desert covers 95–108 heist progression; Anachronia is required for the 108–120 heist ceiling (~1.6–2.26m).

region_issues.issue: Light Form + Crystal Mask (best pickpocket success package) is Tirannwn-locked via The Light Within, with Ancient Curses also requiring Temple at Senntisten multi-region recursion.
region_issues.impact: AFK 100–120 pickpocket (professors, vyres, traders) degrades hard without Tirannwn even if the training location is Misthalin/Morytania.

region_issues.issue: Ring of Vitur is Morytania-only (Darkmeyer stall / chests / vyre consumers).
region_issues.impact: Global +5% pickpocket success and Darkmeyer free-slot anti-aggression are Morytania premiums, not free global gear.

region_issues.issue: Archaeology professors appear at multi-region dig sites, but Archaeology Campus (Misthalin) is a starting-region AFK option at 108.
region_issues.impact: Do not force Desert/Anachronia solely for professors; do force dig-site region when routing materials.

region_issues.issue: Vault of Hereditas needs Breaking the Seal (Archaeology mystery at Kharid-et) — soft Archaeology dependency inside Desert.
region_issues.impact: Desert Thieving heist is not pure Thieving-only; Archaeology progression on Kharid-et matters.

region_issues.issue: Existing training-methods.json already covers safecracking (Misthalin/Asgarnia/Kandarin) and multi-step chests (Keldagrim, Cadarn, City of Um, Rasial). Darkmeyer 116 multi-step chest is only referenced here as a Vitur source, not re-seeded as a full method row.
region_issues.impact: If Darkmeyer chest XP/h is needed as a first-class method later, add it separately under morytania.

region_issues.issue: Wiki tags Daemonheim dig site professors as Wilderness League region; this repo's working id is forinthry.
region_issues.impact: Normalize Wilderness → forinthry when merging into planner data.
